Goal file (goals/design.md):

# Crew `design` (wave 0, verdict `design`)

**Goal.** Write ADR-0015 (`docs/adr/0015-agent-worktree-cleanup.md`), amend the ADRs and architecture docs it changes, and have the crew's Sonnet test-writers write the contract tests and fixtures that wave 1 builds against. The run's goal is in `plan.json`: a foundry run leaves no leftover agent worktrees, `worktree-agent-*` branches or stale slots.json entries, for every future session.

**Carries out these `change` verdicts:** worktrees (`change`: meta.json as an input, a durable sweep resolved from the project dir, the isolation fix); foundry (`change`: real merges replace rebases, so the Branch line's `<base>` and ADR-0004's patch-id carry change). Marketplace is `extend` (tests/e2e/ in the module map).

**Full spec:** `plan.md`, sections "Owner decisions at approval" (these override the rest) and "What each crew must do > `design`". Read both before splitting work.

**Done-check** (proved red on main):

```
test -f docs/adr/0015-agent-worktree-cleanup.md && test -f plugins/worktrees/tests/contract-cleanup.test.ts && test -f plugins/worktrees/tests/fixtures/run3.ts && test -f plugins/foundry/tests/contract-roles.test.ts && test -f plugins/foundry/tests/test_contract_leftovers.py && claude plugin validate plugins/worktrees && claude plugin validate plugins/foundry && node --test plugins/foundry/tests/*.check.ts
```

**Judge checks** (the done-check can't see these; the judge must): each ADR-0015 item is decided, not just mentioned; every ADR listed under Amends actually changed; ADR-0004 lines 66, 105 and 126 no longer assume a rebase; the contract tests load and fail on main only for missing producers (the judge runs `claude plugin test plugins/worktrees`, `claude plugin test plugins/foundry` and `python -m unittest discover -s plugins/foundry/tests`, and reads the failures); no `skip` or `todo`; every named case exists; the diagrams trace to real code.

**Owns:**

- `docs/adr/0015-agent-worktree-cleanup.md`
- `docs/adr/0001-self-contained-plugins.md`, `docs/adr/0006-shared-state-in-git-common-dir.md`, `docs/adr/0012-extension-framework.md`, `docs/adr/0013-kit-manifest.md`, `docs/adr/0014-worktrees-declared-read-only-agents.md`
- `docs/architecture.md`, `plugins/foundry/docs/architecture.md`
- `plugins/foundry/docs/adr/0004-scope-repair-and-head-gates.md`, `plugins/foundry/docs/adr/0005-*.md`
- `plugins/foundry/docs/foundry-config.schema.json`
- `plugins/worktrees/tests/contract-cleanup.test.ts`, `plugins/worktrees/tests/fixtures/**`
- `plugins/foundry/tests/contract-roles.test.ts`, `plugins/foundry/tests/test_contract_leftovers.py`, `plugins/foundry/tests/test_contract_retro.py`, `plugins/foundry/tests/fixtures/leftovers/**`, `plugins/foundry/tests/fixtures/roles/**`

Everything else is off limits, in particular all source under `plugins/*/hooks/**`, `plugins/*/agents/**`, `plugins/*/skills/**`, `plugins/*/scripts/**` and `plugins/kit/**`.

**High-impact paths:** none (docs and tests). **Red team:** no.

**Members** (planned, 8 agents total including the lead): architect (`foundry:architect`, design mode, opus, medium; writes ADRs and docs, never tests or check code); TS test-writer (`kit:test-writer`, sonnet, medium; worktrees contract and `fixtures/run3.ts`); Python+TS test-writer (`kit:test-writer`, sonnet, medium; foundry contracts); read-only probe (`general-purpose`, sonnet, medium; isolation root cause, project-dir source, SubagentStop at depth 2, merge-tree on the 62 patch-equivalent branches in a temp clone, never this repo); judge (`foundry:judge`, opus, medium); one repair judge; one spare. No writer: the architect writes the ADR prose.

**Resources:** temp git repos and the merge-tree clone via `mkdtemp` in the OS temp dir. ports: none (no .claude/worktree-setup.*; worktrees gives no PORT_BASE). No test touches this repo's live slots.json, worktrees or `~/.claude`.

**Architecture doc:** `docs/architecture.md`. **ADRs:** `docs/adr/` (this run writes 0015 and amends as listed); foundry's own in `plugins/foundry/docs/adr/` (0004, 0005).

Prompt overrides: none

Members' reports named: none.
